item.title: Warm Music for Morning Tips

turns.text: Add some warm, hopeful music to this clip, nothing too energetic. Keep the whole video and my voice.

item.tests: Tests whether the delivered video adds music matching an explicit mood while preserving the source footage and speech.

answer_sheet.Music mood: Warm and hopeful, with gentle energy rather than a driving beat.
answer_sheet.Footage and length: Use the entire attached 10-second clip without changing its visuals or timing.
answer_sheet.Original audio: Keep my original voice audible and understandable.
answer_sheet.Platform, framing, and added text: Keep the original framing. No added text; no particular platform.

must_haves: The output contains the full original 10-second kitchen-table video, with no new shots or altered playback speed.
Added music is clearly audible and has a warm, hopeful, gentle character rather than an aggressive or high-energy feel.
The woman's original spoken introduction remains audible and understandable throughout.
The added music ends with the video rather than continuing over extra footage or a blank screen.

turns.text: Add some warm, hopeful music to this clip, nothing too energetic. Keep the whole video and my voice.

dialog.agent:
I can help create a gentle soundtrack, but the connected tools can’t mix music into your existing clip while preserving the full video and your voice unchanged.

For the right feel, use **soft piano, warm ambient pads, and a slow, hopeful melody—no vocals or heavy drums**. Keep it low beneath your speech, with a gentle fade-in and fade-out.

If you tell me which video editor you use, I can give you quick steps to add it without cutting the clip or replacing your voice.
dialog.why: It states that the connected tools cannot mix music into the existing clip while preserving the video and voice unchanged, and offers editing guidance instead.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

dialog.agent:
Free settings don’t remove the limitation: the connected tools can generate music, but can’t mix it into your clip while keeping the whole video and your original voice unchanged. I haven’t modified your clip or spent any credits.

I can help create a **separate gentle, hopeful instrumental track** for you to add in a video editor. How long is the clip?
dialog.why: It asks how long the clip is so it can help create a separate instrumental track, and waits for that information.

dialog.agent: The music generator’s minimum length is **15 seconds**. Is a 15-second instrumental okay? You can use its first 10 seconds beneath your full clip, with a gentle fade-out and your voice kept unchanged.
dialog.why: It asks whether a 15-second instrumental is okay and waits for the user's choice.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour couldn’t generate the soundtrack because your account has **insufficient credits**. A 15-second track costs **15 credits**.

No music was created, and your video and voice remain unchanged.

approvals.name: generate_music

style.prompt: Gentle warm hopeful instrumental background music for a spoken personal video. Soft felt piano, warm airy ambient pads, subtle sustained acoustic textures, slow relaxed tempo around 65 BPM. Reassuring, intimate and quietly optimistic, never energetic or dramatic. Sparse arrangement leaving plenty of room for a speaking voice. No vocals, no drums, no strong percussion, no big build or sudden changes. Begin softly with a complete gentle musical phrase within the first 10 seconds, then settle into a soft understated ending.
